note: Judged 2026-10-12 (independent auditor). Section 7.9.4: "If \"mandatory\" is \"true\", at least one node from exactly one of the choice's case branches MUST exist." Tested "at least one node from"; Gap "exactly one of the choice's case branches"; Producer internal/component/config/yang/validator_mandatory.go::mandatoryPresent. Tested holds: TestMandatoryChoiceSatisfiedByACaseNode reports wrap/kind missing for a container with no node of any case (exact path), and accepts a node of one case and a node of a nested choice's case, so a lookup by the choice name alone, or one that ignores nested choices, goes red; records on mandatoryPresent (positive) and missingMandatory (negative). Real entry: walkTree's mandatory loop reaches it from ValidateCustomSections, so the static route choice action and the iface tunnel encapsulation choice kind are refused when empty. Gap holds: data with nodes from two cases is accepted at the first case node found and no other check compares the cases, so the exactly-one half is unmet; the conditional enforcement under a case or list ancestor in the following paragraph is a separate sentence. Whole requirement earns no credit; spec-config-yang-when-unique-choice.
